summary.text: Bob Sullentrop is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 62B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Anquam Mahamoud (D).
A business executive and U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bob Sullentrop earned a B.S. in civil engineering from the University of Minnesota, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as business executive and his military service as the U.S. Marine Corps.

At the time of his 2017 run for office he was vice president of ITCO Allied Engineering Co., and his experience also includes work for the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency and Republican Party roles including 8th Ward Republican chair and treasurer of his local Senate District Republicans.

Sullentrop was a candidate for Minneapolis City Council Ward 8 in 2021, when Andrea Jenkins won with 84.9 percent to his 13.8 percent, and again in 2025, when Soren Stevenson won and Sullentrop received 3.5 percent.
In 2024 he lost the general election for House District 62B to Anquam Mahamoud, who received 87.2 percent of the vote to his 12.4 percent.
